env: A 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell host with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and the VSS repository checked out at `{{repo_root}}`. This generation-focused eval composes stored/uploaded Long Video Summarization from the current `lvs` developer profile as its Foundation. Source video comes from VIOS upload or recorder storage, and the required output path is the LVS REST API `POST /v1/summarize`. Live-stream summarization is intentionally excluded. The build label `an-1` is directory metadata only and must never become a Compose profile.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-ai` to build under `{{repo_root}}/_builds/an-1/`: "Provide video summarization for videos uploaded to or stored through the VIOS recorder. Do not support live-stream summarization. Expose summaries through the existing LVS REST API at POST /v1/summarize." Target `{{platform}}`, select the current `lvs` developer profile as the single Foundation, preserve its VIOS, RT-VLM, Kafka, Logstash, Elasticsearch, Agent, and model peers, remove the unrequested `nvstreamer-lvs` live source, validate the resolved deployment, and stop without deploying.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/an-1/override.env` exists with `FOUNDATION=lvs`, the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, and only customized environment values.

The effective service set retains canonical `lvs-server`, VIOS, `rtvi-vlm`, Kafka, Logstash, Elasticsearch, Agent, and selected model profile keys from the LVS Foundation without duplicating Kafka, Elasticsearch, or LVS services.
`nvstreamer-lvs` and any invented `an-1`, aggregate, or `bp_developer_*` profile key are absent from `COMPOSE_PROFILES` because this build covers stored/uploaded media only.
`{{repo_root}}/_builds/an-1/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`, and `patches/` is absent because `lvs-server` and every selected peer already exist in the root Compose graph.

`{{repo_root}}/_builds/an-1/resolved.yml` exists, contains the selected service graph with filled service environments, and has no service `profiles:` gates, real unresolved `${...}` interpolation, `/path/to/deploy/docker`, or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel; every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type.

`docker compose -f {{repo_root}}/_builds/an-1/resolved.yml config --quiet`, `config --services`, and `config --images` succeed directly and report a non-empty deployment containing the LVS server and its required peers but no live NvStreamer source.

The architecture preview and final response describe VIOS-uploaded or VIOS-recorded media flowing to the LVS REST API, with readiness at `GET /v1/ready`, models at `GET /models`, and summarization at `POST /v1/summarize` using a VIOS-provided `url` or `id`.
The required API output is `choices[0].message.content`; neither the architecture nor final response uses `/v1/stream_summarize` or `/v1/generate_captions` as the output path.

The build directory contains the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) and no copied Foundation `.env`, patched source tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated deploy-skill bundle.
No upstream Compose or config file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified by generation (`git diff --quiet HEAD -- deploy/docker/` returns exit 0).
